mapper.sql: SELECT CHRT.ORG_ID AS "orgId" , ORG.ORGNM AS "orgNm" , SBJ.SBJCT_YR AS "haksaYear" , SBJ.SBJCT_SMSTR AS "haksaTerm" , CHRT.SMSTR_CHRTNM AS "haksaTermNm" , CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AS "smstrChrtId" /* 공통코드명 미매칭 시 원 코드값이 화면에 노출되지 않도록 '-'로 표시 */ , NVL(CRS_GBNCD.CDNM, '-') AS "cmcrsGbnNm" , NVL(SBJCT_TYCD.CDNM, '-') AS "sbjctTycdNm" , NVL(LCTR_GBNCD.CDNM, '-') AS "lctrGbncdNm" , NVL(TO_CHAR(SBJ.CRCLMN_NO), '-') AS "crclmnNo" , SBJ.SBJCT_ID AS "sbjctId" , SBJ.SBJCTNM AS "sbjctNm" , NVL(TO_CHAR(SBJ.DVCLAS_NO), '-') AS "dvclasNo" , NVL(SBJ.DVCLAS_NO, 99999) AS "dvclasSortNo" , '-' AS "schyr" , NVL(SBJ.CMCRS_GBNNM, '-') AS "cmpltnTypeNm" , NVL(TO_CHAR(SBJ.CRDTS), '-') AS "crdts" , NVL(EVL_GBNCD.CDNM, '-') AS "mrkEvlGbnNm" , NVL(PROF.USERNM, SBJ.PROF_ID) AS "professorNm" , NVL(SBJCT_ADM.TUT_USERNM, '-') AS "tutorNm" , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC WHERE ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND NVL(ATNDLC.AUDITYN, 'N') != 'Y' ) AS "stdntCnt" , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC WHERE ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'Y' ) AS "auditCnt" , NVL(SBJ.USEYN, 'N') AS "useYn"

FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CHRT ON SBJ.SBJCT_REF_TYCD = 'SMSTR_CHRT' AND SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON CHRT.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER PROF ON PROF.USER_ID = SBJ.PROF_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ADM.SBJCT_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'TUT' THEN USR.USERNM END) AS TUT_USERNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = ADM.USER_ID GROUP BY ADM.SBJCT_ID ) SBJCT_ADM ON SBJCT_ADM.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD SBJCT_TYCD ON SBJCT_TYCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND SBJCT_TYCD.UP_CD = 'SBJCT_TYCD' AND SBJCT_TYCD.CD = SBJ.SBJCT_TYCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD LCTR_GBNCD ON LCTR_GBNCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND LCTR_GBNCD.UP_CD = 'LCTR_GBNCD' AND LCTR_GBNCD.CD = SBJ.LCTR_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CRS_GBNCD ON CRS_GBNCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND CRS_GBNCD.UP_CD = 'CRS_GBNCD' AND CRS_GBNCD.CD = SBJ.CRS_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD EVL_GBNCD ON EVL_GBNCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND EVL_GBNCD.UP_CD = 'EVL_GBNCD' AND EVL_GBNCD.CD = SBJ.EVL_GBNCD

FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CHRT ON SBJ.SBJCT_REF_TYCD = 'SMSTR_CHRT' AND SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON CHRT.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER PROF ON PROF.USER_ID = SBJ.PROF_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ADM.SBJCT_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'TUT' THEN USR.USERNM END) AS TUT_USERNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = ADM.USER_ID GROUP BY ADM.SBJCT_ID ) SBJCT_ADM ON SBJCT_ADM.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD SBJCT_TYCD ON SBJCT_TYCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND SBJCT_TYCD.UP_CD = 'SBJCT_TYCD' AND SBJCT_TYCD.CD = SBJ.SBJCT_TYCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD LCTR_GBNCD ON LCTR_GBNCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND LCTR_GBNCD.UP_CD = 'LCTR_GBNCD' AND LCTR_GBNCD.CD = SBJ.LCTR_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CRS_GBNCD ON CRS_GBNCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND CRS_GBNCD.UP_CD = 'CRS_GBNCD' AND CRS_GBNCD.CD = SBJ.CRS_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD EVL_GBNCD ON EVL_GBNCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND EVL_GBNCD.UP_CD = 'EVL_GBNCD' AND EVL_GBNCD.CD = SBJ.EVL_GBNCD
mapper.select:
SELECT A.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY A."haksaYear" DESC , A."haksaTerm" DESC , A."sbjctNm" , A."dvclasSortNo" , A."sbjctId" ) AS LINE_NO FROM (
) A
ORDER BY SBJ.SBJCT_YR DESC , SBJ.SBJCT_SMSTR DESC , SBJ.SBJCTNM , SBJ.DVCLAS_NO

SELECT CHRT.ORG_ID AS "orgId" , ORG.ORGNM AS "orgNm" , SBJ.SBJCT_YR AS "haksaYear" , SBJ.SBJCT_SMSTR AS "haksaTerm" , CHRT.SMSTR_CHRTNM AS "haksaTermNm" , CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AS "smstrChrtId" , SBJ.SBJCT_ID AS "sbjctId" , SBJ.SBJCTNM AS "sbjctNm" , NVL(TO_CHAR(SBJ.DVCLAS_NO), '-') AS "dvclasNo" , NVL(PROF.USERNM, SBJ.PROF_ID) AS "profNm" FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CHRT ON SBJ.SBJCT_REF_TYCD = 'SMSTR_CHRT' AND SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON CHRT.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER PROF ON PROF.USER_ID = SBJ.PROF_ID WHERE SBJ.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJ.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}
AND CHRT.ORG_ID = #{orgId}

SELECT CD.CD AS "mrkItmTycd" , CD.CDNM AS "mrkItmTynm" , STNG.MRK_ITM_STNG_ID AS "mrkItmStngId" , CASE WHEN NVL(STNG.MRK_ITM_USEYN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN STNG.MRK_RFLTRT ELSE NULL END AS "mrkRfltrt" , NVL(STNG.MRK_OYN, 'Y') AS "mrkOyn" , NVL(STNG.MRK_ITM_USEYN, 'N') AS "mrkItmUseyn" FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG STNG ON STNG.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND STNG.MRK_ITM_TYCD = CD.CD
AND 1 = 0
WHERE CD.UP_CD = 'MRK_ITM_TYCD' AND CD.UP_CD != CD.CD AND CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND CD.USEYN = 'Y' ORDER BY CD.CD_SEQNO

SELECT SBJ.SBJCT_ID AS "sbjctId" , NVL(TO_CHAR(SBJ.DVCLAS_NO), '-') AS "dvclasNo" , SBJ.SBJCTNM AS "sbjctNm" , NVL(TO_CHAR(SBJ.CRCLMN_NO), '-') AS "crclmnNo" , ORG.ORGNM AS "orgNm" FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CHRT ON SBJ.SBJCT_REF_TYCD = 'SMSTR_CHRT' AND SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON CHRT.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID WHERE SBJ.DELYN = 'N' AND CHRT.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND SBJ.SBJCT_YR = #{haksaYear} AND SBJ.SBJCT_SMSTR = #{haksaTerm}
AND LOWER(ORG.ORGNM) = LOWER(#{orgNm})
AND ( TO_CHAR(SBJ.CRCLMN_NO) = #{crclmnNo} OR (#{crclmnNo} = '-' AND SBJ.CRCLMN_NO IS NULL) )
AND LOWER(SBJ.SBJCTNM) = LOWER(#{sbjctNm})
ORDER BY NVL(SBJ.DVCLAS_NO, 99999), SBJ.SBJCT_ID
